name: sudoku-solver-share-tests
description: Tests for the step where a shared screenshot's reading becomes a tab (web/pwa.ts's handToTab). Its own suite because it belongs to neither neighbour: tests/ui boots the real page under jsdom, which can neither decode an image nor start OpenCV, so a whole share there never reaches this step; tests/reader ends at the reading and knows nothing about tabs. Runs straight off the .ts source via Node's native type-stripping, against a hand-built window.
